source_text:
XX. Ὑμεῖς μὲν οὖν ἠξιώσατε διὰ πλειόνων δηλωθῆναι ὑμῖν τὰ γενόμενα· ἡμεῖς δὲ κατὰ τὸ παρὸν ὡς ἐν κεφαλαίῳ μεμηνύκαμεν διὰ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ἡμῶν Μαρκίωνος. Μαθόντες οὖν ταῦτα καὶ τοῖς ἐπέκεινα ἀδελφοῖς τὴν ἐπιστολὴν διαπέμψασθε, ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖνοι δοξάσωσι τὸν κύριον, τὸν ἐκλογὰς ποιούμενον τῶν ἰδίων δούλων. Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ πάντας ἡμᾶς εἰσαγαγεῖν ἐν τῇ αὐτοῦ χάριτι καὶ δωρεᾷ εἰς τὴν ἐπουράνιον αὐτοῦ βασιλείαν, διὰ παιδὸς αὐτοῦ τοῦ μονογενοῦς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, δόξα, τιμή, κράτος, μεγαλωσύνη εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας. Προσαγορεύετε πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους. Ὑμᾶς οἱ σὺν ἡμῖν προσαγορεύουσιν καὶ Εὐάρεστος ὁ γράψας πανοικεί.

XXI. Μαρτυρεῖ δὲ ὁ μακάριος Πολύκαρπος μηνὸς Ξανθικοῦ δευτέρᾳ ἱσταμένου, πρὸ ἑπτὰ καλανδῶν Μαΐων, σαββάτῳ μεγάλῳ, ὥρᾳ ὀγδόῃ· συνελήφθη ὑπὸ Ἡρώδου ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Φιλίππου Τραλλιανοῦ, ἀνθυπατεύοντος Στατίου Κοδράτου, βασιλεύοντος δὲ εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· ᾧ ἡ δόξα, τιμή, μεγαλωσύνη, θρόνος αἰώνιος ἀπὸ γενεᾶς εἰς γενεάν, ἀμήν.

XXII. Ἐρρῶσθαι ὑμᾶς εὐχόμεθα, ἀδελφοί, στοιχοῦντας τῷ κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον λόγῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ· δι᾽ οὗ δόξα τῷ θεῷ ἐπὶ σωτηρίᾳ τῇ τῶν ἁγίων ἐκλεκτῶν, καθὼς ἐμαρτύρησεν ὁ μακάριος Πολύκαρπος, οὗ γένοιτο ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πρὸς τὰ ἴχνη εὑρεθῆναι ἡμᾶς.

Ταῦτα μετεγράψατο μὲν Γάϊος ἐκ τῶν Εἰρηναίου, μαθητοῦ τοῦ Πολυκάρπου, ὃς καὶ συνεπολιτεύσατο τῷ Εἰρηναίῳ. Ἐγὼ δὲ Σωκράτης ἐν Κορίνθῳ ἐκ τῶν Γαΐου ἀντιγράφων ἔγραψα. Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων.

Ἐγὼ δὲ πάλιν Πιόνιος ἐκ τοῦ προγεγραμμένου ἔγραψα ἀναζητήσας αὐτά, κατὰ ἀποκάλυψιν φανερώσαντός μοι τοῦ μακαρίου Πολυκάρπου, καθὼς δηλώσω ἐν τῷ καθεξῆς, συναγαγὼν αὐτὰ ἤδη σχεδὸν ἐκ τοῦ χρόνου κεκμηκότα, ἵνα κἀμὲ συναγάγῃ ὁ κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς μετὰ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἐπουράνιον βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ· ᾧ ἡ δόξα σὺν πατρὶ καὶ ἁγίῳ πνεύματι εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων, ἀμήν.
thought_title: Farewell greeting, date, and copying of the letter
orientation: The church of Smyrna finishes its account of Polycarp and sends it to Philomelium, then copyists add when he died and how the text was preserved.
pass_a_gloss: You on your part asked to have the things that happened made clear to you by means of fuller account. But we for the present have made them known as in summary through our brother Marcian. Therefore when you learn these things send on the letter also to the brothers beyond, in order that those also may glorify the Lord, the one who makes choices of his own slaves. But to the one who is able to lead in all of us by his grace and gift into his heavenly kingdom, through his child the only begotten Jesus Christ, be glory, honor, power, greatness into the ages. Greet all the holy ones. Those with us greet you, and Evarestus who wrote with whole house. But blessed Polycarp suffers martyrdom on the second day of the month Xanthicus now standing, seven days before the Kalends of May, on a great Sabbath, at the eighth hour. He was seized by Herod when Philip of Tralles was high priest, when Statius Quadratus was proconsul, but Jesus Christ reigns into the ages. To whom be glory, honor, greatness, eternal throne from generation to generation, amen. We pray that you be well, brothers, walking in line with the word of Jesus Christ according to the gospel. Through whom be glory to God for salvation of the holy chosen ones, as blessed Polycarp suffered martyrdom, to whose footsteps may we be found to come into the kingdom of Jesus Christ. These things Gaius copied out from the writings of Irenaeus, disciple of Polycarp, who also shared common life with Irenaeus. But I Socrates in Corinth wrote from the copies of Gaius. Grace be with all. But I again Pionius wrote from what was written before after searching them out, when blessed Polycarp made them plain to me according to revelation, as I will make clear in what follows in order, after gathering them already almost worn out by time, in order that the Lord Jesus Christ may also gather me with his chosen ones into his heavenly kingdom. To whom be glory with Father and Holy Spirit into the ages of the ages, amen.

lemmas.gloss: now in course, in date formula
walking in line, following in order

choices.why: keeps the head / summary image and the limiting ὡς, rather than smoothing to manner
literal rendering of ποιέω plus accusative, keeps source syntax instead of importing election doctrine
literal adverbial sense that the household joined in the writing / greeting

choices.term: στοιχοῦντας τῷ κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον λόγῳ
choices.english: walking in line with the word according to the gospel
choices.why: preserves the orderly march metaphor of στοιχέω and keeps λόγῳ as word rather than doctrine

pass_b_english: You asked to be told what happened in fuller detail. For the present we have made it known to you as in summary through our brother Marcian. Now that you have learned these things, send our letter on to the brothers beyond you, so that they too may glorify the Lord, the one who makes choices of his own servants.

To him who is able to lead us all by his grace and gift into his heavenly Kingdom through his only-begotten Child Jesus Christ belong glory and honor and power and greatness forever. Greet all the saints for us. Those with us greet you, and Evarestus who wrote this with whole house greets you.

The blessed Polycarp suffered martyrdom on the second day of the month of Xanthicus now in course, seven days before the Kalends of May, on the Great Sabbath at the eighth hour. Herod arrested him while Philip of Tralles was high priest and Statius Quadratus was proconsul, while Jesus Christ reigns forever. To him belong glory and honor and greatness and an eternal throne from generation to generation. Amen.

We pray that you farewell, brothers, as you keep walking in line with the word according to the gospel of Jesus Christ. Through him be glory to God for the salvation of the holy elect, as the blessed Polycarp suffered martyrdom. May we be found at his footsteps in the Kingdom of Jesus Christ.

Gaius copied this account out from the writings of Irenaeus, the disciple of Polycarp, who also shared his life with Irenaeus. I, Socrates, wrote it in Corinth from the copies of Gaius. Grace be with all. I, Pionius, in turn wrote it again from what was written before, after I had searched it out, because the blessed Polycarp appeared to me in a revelation, as I shall explain in what follows. I gathered the pages when they were already almost worn out by time, so that the Lord Jesus Christ may gather me also with his elect into his heavenly Kingdom. To him be glory with the Father and the Holy Spirit forever and ever. Amen.
